description: This file defines data models related to the domain layer of an Islamic Prayer Companion app, including City information, user modes, prayer names, and prayer times with associated utility functions.

classes.name: City
classes.description: Represents a city with its name, country, and geographical coordinates.

classes.name: UserMode
classes.description: Defines user modes such as guest or Google login.

classes.name: PrayerName
classes.description: Enumerates the five daily Islamic prayer names with display labels.

classes.name: PrayerTimes
classes.description: Holds prayer times for a specific date and timezone, with a utility method to convert times into pairs with prayer names.

methods.name: PrayerTimes.asPairs
methods.description: Returns a list of pairs associating each prayer name with its corresponding time.
